plugins.name: Snowflake Maker
plugins.summary: Make random sixfold snowflakes with repeatable seeds, editable branches and colours.
plugins.description: Insert a fresh random snowflake, then try new seeds with New snowflake. Surprise me, stellar, fern and simple shapes; branch levels, spread, line width, centre detail, rotation and colour. Every snowflake has six identical, mirrored arms. Saved seeds keep artwork stable across redraws, undo, save/load and ordinary SVG or offline HTML exports. Private Edit preview with Apply/Cancel. Pure SVG, no network access or external runtime dependencies.

screenshots.caption: Six seeded snowflakes, drawn with the plugin's vector geometry

changelog.notes: Seeded random sixfold snowflakes, three branch styles, editable detail and colours, private previews and portable SVG.
